exit 0
--- stdout
Evaluate whether a git commit should be allowed for the given task.
Used by the per-worktree pre-commit hook installed by wt-create. Exits 0 to
allow the commit and 1 to reject it. On any evaluation error the command exits
0 (fail-safe allow) — the hook is a guard against stale-state mutations, not
an authoritative lock.
Usage:
liza check-commit-allowed <task-id> [flags]
Flags:
-h, --help help for check-commit-allowed
--json output result as structured JSON
Global Flags:
--check-update check for a Liza update before running
-C, --project-root string Liza project root for state commands
--update-channel string update check channel: stable or main (default "stable")
-v, --verbose verbose output
--- stderr
